comment: Single source of truth for every effect. Run tools/gen_effects.py after editing (the build does it too). Never remove or rename an 'id' once released. 'since' = Daylight_aw version that first included the effect. 'released' = date Airwindows first published it. 'tail' = seconds of reverb/delay tail. 'release': 'version' must match CMakeLists.txt; 'date' = release date of this Daylight_aw version; 'newMonths' = how far back the New folder reaches from 'date'; 'previous' = the Daylight_aw version before this one (empty for the first release). The Last added folder shows effects whose 'since' equals 'version' when 'previous' is set.
